attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"She would find the man who took her father’s life and end him.","severity":"major","reason":"Contradicts the briefing: Malley, who killed Joska, already died in the same fight."},{"span":"his heavy, notched blade","severity":"major","reason":"Introduces a specific weapon the briefing never mentions."},{"span":"the jagged scar on her father’s chest","severity":"minor","reason":"Embellishes the maiming with an unstated wound and location."},{"span":"where the new captain sat","severity":"minor","reason":"Places the new captain within sight of the body, which the briefing does not say."}],"voice":3,"clarity":2,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The ending has Tamsin vowing to kill her father's killer, but the briefing says Malley is already dead; the heir's aim should have been the new captain or the Lancers. The scene also contradicts itself: she traces the scar on her father's body, then his body lies 'a few feet away'."}
